description: This file defines typography styles for a TV application UI using Jetpack Compose. It includes a data class for typography tokens, default typography instances with font sizes, weights, line heights, and letter spacing, as well as utility functions for converting pixel values to em units.

classes.name: TvTypography
classes.description: A data class encapsulating various text styles used for typography across the TV app UI, including styles for title, label, body, badge, navigation, and active navigation states.

methods.name: pxToEm
methods.description: Converts a letter spacing value from pixels to em units based on the font size. Used internally to translate pixel letter spacing values into em units compatible with Compose TextStyle.
